doc.name: ENYAL by Greenland AI
doc.instructions:
ENYAL by Greenland AI — identity, OAuth & cryptographic trust layer for AI agents.

ENYAL encrypted-memory query. STRUCTURE tools (query_memory / get_entity / get_timeline / render) return graph STRUCTURE only (node_type, name_hash, relationships, chunk_ids, timestamps) — no content. CONTENT tools (query_memory_content / get_entity_content / get_timeline_content / get_node_content) return DECRYPTED content (names, summaries, evidence) and REQUIRE a memory:read:content-scoped token — a structure-only token calling them is rejected (403) by ENYAL. Same plan schema for both surfaces. Listing the tools (initialize, tools/list) needs no credential; every tool call needs your own ENYAL key (eyl_…) as Authorization: Bearer — this server holds none. Every tool is read-only.

tools.name: query_memory
tools.description:
Execute a structured query plan over your encrypted knowledge graph. Returns STRUCTURE ONLY
    (node_type, name_hash, relationships, chunk_ids, timestamps) — never content.

    Plan schema:
      {
        "entity_filters": [{"node_type": <type>} | {"name_hash": <sha256-hex>}],
        "edge_filters":   [{"relationship": <rel>, "direction": "out"|"in"|"both"}],
        "temporal_bounds":{"valid_from_after": <ISO8601>, "valid_to_before": <ISO8601>},
        "limit": <int <= 200>,
        "include_neighbours_depth": <0-5>
      }
    node_type in {entity, concept, decision, person, organisation, event, source, synthesis}.
    relationship in {references, contradicts, supports, supersedes, caused_by, related_to,
    part_of, informed_by, led_to, verifies}. Account scope is enforced server-side; it cannot be
    set from the plan.

plan.description: The structured query plan (a JSON object): entity_filters [{node_type} | {name_hash}], edge_filters [{relationship, direction out|in|both}], temporal_bounds {valid_from_after, valid_to_before} (ISO 8601), limit (<= 200), include_neighbours_depth (0-5). The schema and the allowed node_type / relationship values are in this tool's description.
plan.title: Plan

include_chunks.description: Also return the chunk ids behind each node. Default false.
include_chunks.title: Include Chunks

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get one entity's STRUCTURE by name_hash (SHA-256 of the normalised name). No content.

name_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the entity's normalised name. Send it: without it the plan has no entity filter.
name_hash.title: Name Hash

node_id.description: Accepted for compatibility but NOT used yet: the lookup is by name_hash only.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: get_timeline
tools.description:
Temporally-ordered STRUCTURE view, optionally filtered by node_type and an ISO8601 date
    range. No content.

node_type.description: Only nodes of this type: entity, concept, decision, person, organisation, event, source or synthesis. Empty = all.
node_type.title: Node Type

valid_from_after.description: Only nodes valid from after this time (ISO 8601). Empty = no lower bound.
valid_from_after.title: Valid From After

valid_to_before.description: Only nodes valid to before this time (ISO 8601). Empty = no upper bound.
valid_to_before.title: Valid To Before

tools.name: render
tools.description:
Render a structured query as a STRUCTURE-ONLY result set (β = structure; identical shape to
    query_memory). Reserved for richer rendering when content access (γ) lands.

plan.description: The structured query plan (a JSON object): entity_filters [{node_type} | {name_hash}], edge_filters [{relationship, direction out|in|both}], temporal_bounds {valid_from_after, valid_to_before} (ISO 8601), limit (<= 200), include_neighbours_depth (0-5). The schema and the allowed node_type / relationship values are in this tool's description.
plan.title: Plan

tools.name: verify_chunk
tools.description:
Look up one identifier in ENYAL's PUBLIC verification index (relays GET /api/v1/verify/lookup/{id}; no decryption). ENYAL's
    answer is returned unchanged: `found`, and for a chunk or proof its `anchor_status` with `bsv_tx_id`; for a txid, `chain_status`.
    `degraded:true` means a source could not be checked (inconclusive, not an absence). ENYAL's route needs no key; calling it through
    this server still needs your eyl_ bearer, like every tool call. An id that is not a UUID or hex is refused (invalid_id) and nothing
    is sent.

identifier.description: The id to look up: a chunk, proof or transfer id (UUID), or a BSV transaction id (hex), 8-64 characters.
identifier.title: Identifier

tools.name: query_memory_content
tools.description:
Execute a structured query plan and return DECRYPTED memory CONTENT (node names, summaries,
    properties; edge evidence + endpoint names) alongside structure. SAME plan schema as query_memory.
    REQUIRES a memory:read:content-scoped token — a structure-only token is rejected (403) by ENYAL.
    Account scope is enforced server-side; it cannot be set from the plan.

plan.description: The structured query plan (a JSON object): entity_filters [{node_type} | {name_hash}], edge_filters [{relationship, direction out|in|both}], temporal_bounds {valid_from_after, valid_to_before} (ISO 8601), limit (<= 200), include_neighbours_depth (0-5). The schema and the allowed node_type / relationship values are in this tool's description.
plan.title: Plan

include_chunks.description: Also return the chunk ids behind each node. Default false.
include_chunks.title: Include Chunks

tools.name: get_entity_content
tools.description:
Get one entity's DECRYPTED content by name_hash (SHA-256 of the normalised name).
    Content scope required (403 otherwise).

name_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the entity's normalised name. Send it: without it the plan has no entity filter.
name_hash.title: Name Hash

node_id.description: Accepted for compatibility but NOT used yet: the lookup is by name_hash only.
node_id.title: Node Id

tools.name: get_timeline_content
tools.description:
Temporally-ordered DECRYPTED content view, optionally filtered by node_type + an ISO8601
    date range. Same plan schema as get_timeline. Content scope required (403 otherwise).

node_type.description: Only nodes of this type: entity, concept, decision, person, organisation, event, source or synthesis. Empty = all.
node_type.title: Node Type

valid_from_after.description: Only nodes valid from after this time (ISO 8601). Empty = no lower bound.
valid_from_after.title: Valid From After

valid_to_before.description: Only nodes valid to before this time (ISO 8601). Empty = no upper bound.
valid_to_before.title: Valid To Before

tools.name: get_node_content
tools.description:
Get a node's DECRYPTED content by name_hash PLUS its connected nodes' content (neighbour
    depth, default 1; 0–5). Same plan schema as the structure tools. Content scope required (403).

name_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the entity's normalised name. Send it: without it the plan has no entity filter.
name_hash.title: Name Hash

include_neighbours_depth.description: How many hops of connected nodes to include, 0-5 (clamped). Default 1.
include_neighbours_depth.title: Include Neighbours Depth
